verdict.rationale: Mintlify's own automations feature runs its agent on a recurring schedule, as well as on repository pushes and integration events. Pre-built automations cover common cases, so this is a genuine first-party recurring schedule, not a one-off trigger. missing for 10: details on schedule granularity or cron configuration, scheduling of jobs beyond agent content maintenance, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Automate content maintenance with Mintlify automations by running the agent on a schedule, on repository pushes, or on connected integration events.
We redesigned automations for quicker setup with pre-built automations optimized for common use cases.
